cat1-class1.name: Category 1 / Class 1 — Clean Water, Minor
cat1-class1.description: Clean water source (supply line, sink overflow), minimal area affected, porous materials salvageable
cat1-class1.equipmentRatio: 1 dehu per 1-2 rooms, 1 air mover per 10-16 LF of wall
cat1-class1.notes: Per IICRC S500 Section 12. Drying goal: materials to pre-loss moisture levels.

cat1-class2.name: Category 1 / Class 2 — Clean Water, Significant
cat1-class2.description: Clean water, larger area, wet carpet/pad, water wicking up walls <24 inches
cat1-class2.equipmentRatio: 1 dehu per room, 1 air mover per 10-16 LF of wall, minimum 3 air movers per dehu
cat1-class2.notes: Flood cuts at 2 feet typical. Pad usually non-salvageable. IICRC S500 Section 12.

cat1-class3.name: Category 1 / Class 3 — Clean Water, Major
cat1-class3.description: Clean water, soaked ceilings/walls/insulation, water overhead or extensive saturation
cat1-class3.equipmentRatio: 1 dehu per room, air movers on walls AND ceiling, HEPA air scrubber recommended
cat1-class3.notes: Longest drying time. May require ceiling removal. IICRC S500 Section 12.

cat2-class2.name: Category 2 / Class 2 — Gray Water, Significant
cat2-class2.description: Dishwasher, washing machine, toilet (urine only). Contaminated but not sewage.
cat2-class2.equipmentRatio: Same as Cat 1 Class 2, plus antimicrobial treatment mandatory
cat2-class2.notes: Antimicrobial required per IICRC S500. Pad always non-salvageable. Soft contents in contact may need cleaning.

cat3-class2.name: Category 3 / Class 2 — Black Water, Significant
cat3-class2.description: Sewage backup, river/flood water, ground surface water. Maximum contamination.
cat3-class2.equipmentRatio: Maximum equipment. HEPA air scrubber mandatory. Full PPE required.
cat3-class2.notes: IICRC S500 Section 14. All porous materials in contact must be removed. Antimicrobial + sanitization required. Document contamination thoroughly.

cat3-class4.name: Category 3 / Class 4 — Black Water, Specialty Drying
cat3-class4.description: Sewage/flood water with deep saturation into hardwood, plaster, concrete, stone
cat3-class4.equipmentRatio: Specialty drying: heat injection, desiccant dehu, injectidry panels. Extended monitoring.
cat3-class4.notes: Longest dry times. Specialty equipment justified. IICRC S500 Section 14 + S520 for mold prevention. Document daily with photos.
